key_provisions.(a) Authority: Adopted under article VI, § 6 of California Constitution and Family Code §§ 211, 3160, 3162(a)
key_provisions.(d)(1) Court duties: Ensure mediators are impartial, competent; detailed intake screens for restraining orders and safety
key_provisions.(e)(6) Suspension on abuse allegations: Suspend if child abuse/neglect allegations made until agency investigation completed
key_provisions.(f) Training: 40 hours initial within 6 months; 8 hours annual CE plus 4-hour DV update per §§ 1815/1816
key_provisions.(h) Ethics: 12 requirements including objectivity, confidentiality, conflicts of interest

steward_case_relevance_audit.purpose: Map CRC Rule 5.210 against the steward's 16-year custody history. This rule governs the mediation process that should have occurred at every custody dispute. The audit asks whether mediation standards were met, particularly: intake screening, safety protocols, ethics compliance, and whether suspension occurred when abuse allegations arose.
steward_case_relevance_audit.audit_filed_by: Claude (assistant) at first-mouth level; steward review required

factor_audits.factor_id: (d)(1) Intake screening for restraining orders and safety
factor_audits.audit_recommendation: Every mediation session should have been preceded by detailed screening for existing restraining orders and safety concerns. The audit asks: was intake screening documented? Were existing DVRO/CLETS entries checked before sessions began?
factor_audits.audit_status: CRITICAL — intake screening compliance must be verified against case file

factor_audits.audit_recommendation: Mediation must suspend if child abuse or neglect allegations are made, until agency investigation is completed. The audit asks: if abuse allegations were raised during the 16-year history, was mediation properly suspended? Or did it continue without investigation completion?
factor_audits.audit_status: CRITICAL — directly relevant to orchestration pattern where allegations were used as tactical instruments

factor_audits.audit_recommendation: Mediation must terminate if the mediator cannot achieve balanced discussion. If one party was operating within an orchestrated framework (project_familylaw_orchestration.md), the power imbalance should have triggered termination.
factor_audits.audit_status: FLAGGED — requires review of mediation session records

factor_audits.audit_recommendation: All mediators must have completed 40 hours initial training plus annual CE. The audit asks: were the mediators in the steward's case properly credentialed per §§ 1815/1816?

Mediators must not offer recommendations about a party unless evaluated directly or through consultation. The audit asks: were any custody recommendations made about the steward without direct evaluation?
factor_audits.audit_status: FLAGGED — directly relevant to unsigned report pattern

factor_audits.audit_recommendation: Mediators must disclose conflicts of interest and dual relationships. The audit asks: were any mediators connected to the orchestration network or had prior involvement with either party?
